description: Evidence-layer feature lexicon: the columns of the repos-vs-specs evidence matrix. Each feature is a binary observable with declared witness loci per document type; `maps_to` is the catalog decision the observation is evidence for, or null for a catalog-gap candidate. The 2026.08.25-2 blind-node coverage pass adds at least two opposing observables for each of the 33 catalog nodes that previously had no feature at all, so no decision is structurally invisible to the matrix; pure-policy nodes (late fee basis, walk-ins, cancellation rules) ship with an empty `repo` locus list because a repository genuinely cannot witness them.
